# OpenRouter fixtures

Labelled `docs-example`: shapes follow OpenRouter's API reference (responses, errors, models, key) as
reconstructed in the build environment, which could not reach openrouter.ai. Model IDs and prices in
`models-list.docs-example.json` are test values for the roster picker, not a statement of what OpenRouter lists.

Replace with sanitised real bodies recorded by `smoke.yml` (decide-all / roster) and keep the file names.
